jurisdiction: India, Income-tax Act 2025 and Income-tax Rules 2026 (tax year 2026-27 onwards)
approved_by: UNAPPROVED PROTOTYPE - a tax lead must verify every value against the treaty text before use

domestic.provision: Income-tax Act 2025 s.207(2) (erstwhile s.115A of the 1961 Act); lower of treaty or domestic rate under s.159(4) (erstwhile s.90(2))

assumptions: Treaty rates are applied as flat rates with no surcharge or cess added. This is common practice but must be confirmed by the certifying CA.
Equipment-royalty sub-rates (10% under the US and UK treaties) are not modelled.
Most-favoured-nation rate cuts are applied only once recorded here from a government notification (Supreme Court, AO v. Nestle SA, 2023).
